name: USDA PSD: soybean and corn production, exports, ending stocks, imports and domestic consumption (key countries, market years 2022-2026)
source: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service, Production, Supply and Distribution (PSD) online bulk file psd_alldata_csv.zip
publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Foreign Agricultural Service (USDA FAS)
license_detail: USDA FAS PSD data are a U.S. Government work (public domain); attribution/citation of USDA FAS is recommended, not required.
frequency: marketing year (annual PSD aggregate; monthly PSD release)
coverage: Oilseed, Soybean (2222000) and Corn (0440000); United States, Brazil, Argentina, China, European Union (+Ukraine for corn); market years 2022-2026; attributes Production, Exports, Ending Stocks, Imports, Domestic Consumption; 275 observations
notes: Compact slice of the official public bulk CSV: 2 commodities x 5-6 countries x 5 market years x 5 attributes. The full ~202 MB psd_alldata.csv and the ~10.5 MB zip are NOT committed; only this aggregate is. No World total exists as a row in psd_alldata and no World aggregate is computed here (the file carries the 'European Union' aggregate and its member states, so naive summation would double-count; 'Other' is not a world residual). No PIT/vintage history: psd_alldata holds one current value per (commodity, country, market year, attribute) and a 2-digit release Month column that is retained verbatim as source_month and NOT interpreted; a new monthly bulk can revise historical values, so this pin is a dated snapshot, not a revision archive. No forecasts, no assumptions, no re-sale. Citation: USDA FAS, PSD, 2026-11-26.
